name: marketo
description: Reads Marketo REST records, exposes bounded direct reads for lookup/content endpoints, and plans typed Marketo reverse-ETL mutations from the official AdobeDocs Swagger assets.

risk.read: external Marketo REST API reads through fixture-backed ETL streams and bounded redacted direct reads
risk.write: external Marketo mutations through typed reverse ETL only; no generic raw API command is exposed
risk.approval: reverse ETL writes require plan, preview, approval token, and execute; destructive actions also require typed confirmation
